feed.title: AeroAid · Scholarship directory updates
feed.subtitle: Public directory additions, including closed cycles and unverified leads. Check providers.

entry.title: CadetInvest Academic Scholarships
entry.summary: Civil Air Patrol — Typically $1,000–$2,500, varies by award. Active CAP cadet in good standing, Billy Mitchell Award or higher, at least a high-school senior at application and age 17 by March 1, 2027. No CAP scholarship received in the prior three years. Show that you have applied or been accepted to a school, and be enrolled during the award year. Several general awards explicitly accept postsecondary vocational or technical education with no completed degree or A&P required. AIM NJ's 21-month A&P certificate can fit that published study category if you meet the individual award rules and attend in the award year. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: IEC Foundation Scholarship · electrical training
entry.summary: Independent Electrical Contractors Foundation — Amount not published. IEC students, members or their immediate families pursuing postsecondary college study or a state-accredited apprenticeship for an electrical career. The New Jersey IEC chapter lists this for its apprentices. The apprenticeship route does not require a completed college degree. Aviation maintenance is outside the verified field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Automotive Women's Alliance Foundation Education Scholarship
entry.summary: Automotive Women's Alliance Foundation — Current award amount not published. North American citizen with college or university acceptance and a 3.0 minimum GPA during the funded semester. The foundation supports women pursuing careers in automotive, vehicular or mobility fields. Its current rules do not specify a degree level, a completed degree requirement or whether a standalone trade certificate qualifies. Confirm a college-based certificate with the sponsor. AIM NJ A&P eligibility is unconfirmed. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Dr. Carolyn Ghazal Dental Assistant Scholarship
entry.summary: PDS Health Foundation — Up to $5,000 toward tuition. Age 18+, high-school diploma or GED, and enrolled in an accredited U.S. vocational dental-assistant certification program through award. High-school programs and previous applicants are excluded. GPA 3.0 or good academic standing. Selection considers financial need and service. No completed college degree is required. AIM NJ aviation maintenance is outside the required field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Essential Visionaries Scholarship Fund
entry.summary: Scholarship America — Up to $5,000 at vocational or two-year schools. U.S. resident who is a high-school senior, high-school or GED graduate, or current undergraduate. GPA 2.5+. Enroll for the full upcoming academic year at an accredited eligible U.S. institution in an undergraduate degree or certificate in education, counseling, social work, psychology, nursing or pre-nursing. Certificates must run at least one term on a standard semester calendar. A K–12 career commitment applies except in nursing. No completed degree is required. Prior-degree applicants should confirm eligibility. AIM NJ aviation maintenance is outside the listed fields. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Veteran Scholarship for Educators
entry.summary: Scholarship America — $1,000 certification or $5,000 vocational/two-year degree. U.S. military veteran honorably discharged and no longer serving or drilling by July 2027. High-school/GED graduate or current postsecondary student, GPA 2.0+, financial need and intent to work in K–12 education, school counseling, school social work or school psychology. Pursue an associate, bachelor's or master's at an accredited eligible school for the full academic year, or a state-approved alternative certification pathway. A completed degree is not required by the scholarship itself. Confirm any degree required by the certification program. AIM NJ A&P is outside the listed fields. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: HVAC HERO Scholarship · in-person trade school
entry.summary: EGIA Foundation — $2,500 toward training costs. U.S. citizen, national or permanent resident with a 2.0 minimum GPA and current or planned enrollment in an accredited in-person HVAC associate degree, diploma or certificate program. Provide program documentation. Employees of EGIA or its foundation and their children are excluded. High-school seniors and ages 18–26 receive preference. No completed college degree is stated. AIM NJ A&P is outside the HVAC program requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Wells Fargo Veterans Emergency Grant
entry.summary: Wells Fargo / Scholarship America — Up to $1,000 for an eligible emergency. Honorably discharged U.S. veteran, including Reserves or National Guard, or a spouse or surviving spouse of an eligible disabled veteran. Use available military education benefits. Be currently enrolled full-time for the full academic year in a first associate, bachelor's or master's degree at an accredited eligible institution, including a vocational-technical school that offers the required degree. GPA 2.0+ and an unexpected expense that threatens continued enrollment are required. Current AIM NJ certificate study alone does not meet the degree rule. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Red Wing Build the Future Scholarship
entry.summary: Red Wing Shoe Company / SkillsUSA — $2,500. 2026–27 SkillsUSA student member and high-school senior or postsecondary student planning eligible spring 2027 study. Accredited trade school, technical or community college, apprenticeship and certificate programs qualify. Aviation Maintenance Technology is explicitly listed, alongside automotive/diesel, building maintenance and industrial technology. No completed degree is required. Confirm AIM NJ chapter membership, continuing-enrollment treatment and the applicable store selection before relying on eligibility. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Fluid Power Scholarship
entry.summary: National Fluid Power Association Education and Technology Foundation — $2,500 for tuition. High-school senior or postsecondary student at an accredited U.S. community college, technical college or university. GPA 2.5+. Must study a program that teaches fluid power. The sponsor lists industrial maintenance, automotive, mechatronics, CNC technician and manufacturing-equipment certificates. Current master's/PhD students and college/university students graduating in spring 2027 are excluded. No prior degree is required. AIM NJ’s certificate and school classification require sponsor confirmation. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: NFSF Construction Trades Scholarship
entry.summary: NAWIC Founders’ Scholarship Foundation — Starts at $2,000. Currently enrolled in eligible U.S. construction craft or trade training through an apprenticeship, community college, technical school or equivalent. High-school seniors are eligible. The trades application accepts training/certification without a completed college degree. The separate undergraduate application has degree rules. Donor preferences can vary. AIM NJ aviation maintenance is outside the construction requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Blessons Scholarships for Women · skilled trades
entry.summary: Blessons for Women — Up to $2,000. Women 25+ returning after an interruption to their education, with financial need. At least part-time enrollment in skilled-trade vocational/technical study, continuing education or an associate program. No completed degree is required. The application says regional or ACICS accreditation and accepts U.S. citizens or permanent residents, while the summary refers to U.S. citizens. Confirm permanent-resident eligibility if relevant. AIM NJ is ACCSC-accredited and requires sponsor confirmation under the published accreditation rule. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: SparkForce Manufacturing Scholarships · fall 2027
entry.summary: SparkForce, The FMA Foundation — Up to $2,000 per semester. Manufacturing-related certificate or degree in an approved field such as industrial maintenance, automation, electronics, NDT, welding or precision sheet metal. At least 12 credit hours, or 6 credit hours while working. GPA 2.5+ for trade/community/technical students and 3.0+ for university students. No completed degree required. Sponsor staff, officers and specified relatives are excluded. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance is not listed as an approved field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Don Carrington Vocational and Trade School Scholarship
entry.summary: Rotary Club of Robbinsville Hamilton — $1,000. Graduating high-school senior residing in Mercer County, NJ, who plans to continue at a technical, vocational or trade school. No completed college degree or specific trade is stated. A current AIM NJ student who is already out of high school does not meet this entry-stage requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Education Support Awards · vocational pathway watch
entry.summary: Patsy Takemoto Mink Education Foundation — Up to $5,000 in the last round. Last-round criteria: low-income U.S. resident mother age 17+ with minor children. Full-time study at an accredited U.S. nonprofit institution or program. Vocational credentials are eligible if the new level advances beyond prior education. Repeating a credential level or entering a lower one does not qualify. AIM NJ is proprietary, so its eligibility is not established under the nonprofit requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: PMMI Member Family Scholarship · January application watch
entry.summary: PMMI Foundation — 2027 amount to be confirmed. Last-round rules: employee or specified immediate relative of an employee at a PMMI member company in good standing, GPA 3.0+, and current accredited North American vocational/technical school or two- or four-year college/university study relevant to business. Mechatronics, packaging and processing are preferred. The employer must be a member, while the school need not be a PMMI education partner. No completed degree is stated. AIM NJ A&P fit is unconfirmed. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: GoFoodservice Culinary Arts and Hospitality Scholarship
entry.summary: GoFoodservice — $500. Full- or part-time student in culinary arts or hospitality management at a college or culinary school. The sponsor overview also invites high-school seniors planning to enroll, while its terms say enrolled. Confirm timing if applying before enrollment. No completed degree or state restriction is stated. AIM NJ aviation maintenance is a different field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: PWC New Jersey Construction and Technical Scholarship · closed-cycle watch
entry.summary: Professional Women in Construction, New Jersey Chapter — $2,500 in the last round. Last-round criteria: New Jersey resident or relative of an active PWC NJ member. High-school senior, qualifying undergraduate, or full-time trade/technical student pursuing architecture, engineering or construction-related certificate or degree. Current graduate study is excluded. No completed degree or gender restriction is stated in the chapter rules. AIM NJ aviation maintenance is outside the verified fields. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Track to the Trades Scholarship
entry.summary: SupplyHouse Foundation — $2,500. U.S. legal resident currently attending trade school or a high-school senior entering trade school in plumbing, HVAC, electrical or a closely related field. SupplyHouse also describes relevant apprentices and early-career tradespeople, while the application lists the school-stage criteria. Confirm the appropriate route if those differ for you. No completed degree is required in the published terms. NJ applicants in the listed fields may apply. AIM NJ’s A&P certificate fit is unconfirmed. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Women of NATE Education Scholarship
entry.summary: NATE: The Communications Infrastructure Contractors Association — $2,000. Women entering or advancing in communications infrastructure or tower construction, service or maintenance. Technical school, continuing education and university degree routes are listed. The launch terms do not specify an already-earned degree, prior-degree exclusion, state restriction or membership requirement. Check the 2027 form for documentation and any nomination rule. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance alone does not establish the telecommunications field requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Techs of Tomorrow · automotive tuition and tools
entry.summary: TOPDON Technology USA — $5,000–$12,000 combined tuition + tools. U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident, 18 by the start of coursework, GPA 2.5+, good standing and financial need. Accredited automotive technology associate, certificate or equivalent technician program. Accepted or enrolled applicants qualify by award stage. Under-18 applicants need guardian consent. No completed degree or prior-degree exclusion is listed. NJ automotive students can apply. AIM NJ aviation maintenance is a separate field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Automotive Aftermarket Scholarship · shared application
entry.summary: University of the Aftermarket Foundation — Amount not published. Full-time student at an accredited U.S. college or university or an ASE/NATEF-certified postsecondary automotive, heavy-duty or collision repair school, or a high-school senior planning full-time attendance. The certified trade-school route does not require a completed degree. Donor criteria may vary. NJ applicants in the specified pathways may apply. AIM NJ’s aircraft maintenance certificate does not establish automotive-school eligibility. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Women in Auto Care · scholarships and tool kits
entry.summary: Auto Care Association / Women in Auto Care — Amount not published. Female high-school senior accepted into, or postsecondary student currently in, an accredited college program, with a career plan in the auto care industry and GPA 2.5+. The shared portal also lists ASE/NATEF-certified schools. Confirm that the sponsor accepts your specific NJ school if it is a standalone trade school. The sponsor lists no completed degree or prior-degree bar. AIM NJ aviation maintenance alone does not meet the career requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Collision Repair Student Scholarships and Tool Grants
entry.summary: Collision Repair Education Foundation — Amount not published. Current postsecondary collision-repair students, applicants beginning postsecondary collision study in the relevant summer or fall, and high-school seniors entering collision training or employment. Individual donor rules vary. No completed college degree is required for the program. Eligible NJ collision students can apply. AIM NJ’s A&P certificate is outside the published field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Women’s Industry Network Collision Repair Scholarship
entry.summary: Women’s Industry Network / Collision Repair Education Foundation — Amount not published. Women pursuing automotive collision repair through eligible collision education. The administrator’s shared intake includes high-school and postsecondary pathways. The next WIN application should confirm exact school, enrollment, prior-degree and tool conditions. NJ collision students are in the U.S. scope. AIM NJ A&P alone does not meet the collision-repair requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: 3M Hire Our Heroes · collision repair
entry.summary: 3M / Collision Repair Education Foundation — Amount not published. Postsecondary collision-repair student currently or recently serving in the military, or high-school senior or postsecondary collision student with an immediate family member currently serving or who has served. Veteran applicants are also invited to the general scholarship and tool competition. No completed degree is required in the posted terms. NJ collision students may qualify. AIM NJ A&P is outside the collision-repair field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Nucor Technical Academy · paid electrical maintenance training
entry.summary: Nucor — Hourly wages + full tuition, books and housing. High-school diploma or GED and 18 by September 1 of the entering year. Apply first to Shelton State Community College, then to a sponsoring Nucor division. College placement GPA and testing rules apply. The program requires full-time study toward an Electrical Technology AAS plus employer training, with some postings specifying 27 months. No prior college degree is required. NJ residents can apply for posted out-of-state placements. This does not fund current AIM NJ enrollment. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: PHCC Educational Foundation Scholarships
entry.summary: PHCC Educational Foundation — Amount not published. Legal U.S. resident in an eligible route. Applicants may qualify through a PHCC-approved plumbing or HVACR apprenticeship or eligible online course while working full-time for a licensed PHCC-member contractor. A full-time certificate or degree at an accredited two-year community college, technical college or trade school in an approved plumbing, HVACR, mechanical construction or related major is another route. Canadian citizens have a separate apprenticeship route. No prior completed degree is required in the listed technical routes. NJ field-eligible students may apply. AIM NJ aviation maintenance is outside the approved field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Seymour Siegel Youth Achievement Award · vocational entry
entry.summary: Jewish Community Foundation of Southern New Jersey — Amount not published. Jewish high-school student residing in Burlington, Camden or Gloucester County, NJ, who is an orphan, in foster care or being raised in a single-parent household. Accepted or planning to enroll in college or non-college vocational or technical education. No college degree is required. This is a high-school-entry award. Check the new application for the intended school and the 2027 enrollment rules. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Supplemental Education Grant · closed-cycle watch
entry.summary: Coast Guard Mutual Assistance — Up to $750 per student. Eligible Coast Guard Mutual Assistance member applying for self, spouse or dependent child under 23. A multi-course vocational or technical program approved by VA or the Department of Education can qualify without a current degree. College degree and other routes are separate. Confirm AIM NJ’s specific 21-month A&P certificate with CGMA under this approval rule. The published vocational route does not list a prior-degree exclusion. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Schneider Electric SKILLED Scholarship
entry.summary: Schneider Electric / SKILLED Nation — $3,000. Currently enrolled in an approved U.S. trades program, with training ending at least six weeks after the deadline, and pursuing an energy technology career. Eligible examples include facilities maintenance, electrical systems, HVAC, building automation and energy management. No completed degree is specified and current graduate study is excluded under the shared rules. Employees, spouses and dependents are excluded. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance alone is not confirmed. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Ball Foundation Trades SKILLED Scholarship
entry.summary: The Ball Foundation / SKILLED Nation — $2,500. High school seniors, graduates or GED recipients enrolled or planning to enroll in an approved U.S. manufacturing-related trades program. Examples include industrial maintenance, mechatronics, electrical and electronics technology and automation. No completed degree is specified and current graduate study is excluded under the shared rules. Ball employees, spouses and dependents are excluded. NJ is outside the listed priority locations but not excluded by them. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance is not confirmed. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: The Home Depot Foundation Path to Pro Scholarship
entry.summary: The Home Depot Foundation / SKILLED Nation — $2,500. High school senior, graduate or GED recipient pursuing approved U.S. construction trade training, such as carpentry, electrical, plumbing, HVAC or construction management. Confirm the current two-year institution rule in the program tile. No completed college degree is required in the published description. Sponsor employees and dependents use a separate program. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance is outside the published construction scope. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Connex Foundation Licensed Trades and Facilities Scholarship
entry.summary: Connex Foundation — Up to $5,000. U.S. or Canadian citizen or permanent legal resident, at least a graduating high school senior or equivalent, GPA 2.5+, and plans for full-time study leading to work in licensed trades, construction or facilities management. Technical certificates qualify. Adult re-entry and career transition applicants are eligible. No specific completed degree or prior-degree exclusion is published. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance is not listed as an eligible field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: AWS Welder Training Scholarship
entry.summary: American Welding Society Foundation — $1,000. Residence within an AWS district, including the NJ section of District 2. Must plan to attend a welding certificate program lasting less than two years through an eligible training provider. Current associate or bachelor study is excluded for this award. No completed degree requirement is stated. Section officers, selection committee members and their families are excluded. AIM NJ’s 21-month A&P program is a separate field. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: New Horizons Skilled Trades Scholarship
entry.summary: The Hourglass Foundation — $5,000. U.S. high school senior, graduate or GED holder age 16 or older pursuing automotive repair or technology, engineering technology, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, construction or another approved trade at a trade school or community college. High school GPA 2.0+ or GED. No completed college degree or prior-degree exclusion is published. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance acceptance needs confirmation. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: More Than One Path Skilled Trades Scholarship
entry.summary: The Hourglass Foundation — $5,000. U.S. high school senior, graduate or GED holder age 16–28 as of January 2027, pursuing eligible automotive, engineering technology, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, construction or similar approved trade at a trade school or community college. High school GPA 2.0+ or GED. No completed college degree or prior-degree exclusion is published. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance acceptance needs confirmation. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Geotab Veteran Scholarship for the Trades
entry.summary: The Hourglass Foundation — Up to $15,000. U.S. citizen or permanent resident with qualifying U.S. veteran service, including Guard/Reserve, and an Honorable or General (Under Honorable Conditions) characterization. Must be enrolling or enrolled full time at a U.S. community college in an undergraduate degree in automotive repair/technology, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, construction or similar trades. No completed degree requirement is stated. AIM NJ nondegree study does not meet that enrollment rule. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: NMFA Military Spouse Scholarship
entry.summary: National Military Family Association — Typically $500–$5,000. Qualifying spouse of a post-9/11 service member across the eight uniformed services (active duty, retiree, 100% disabled veteran, Guard, Reserve or fallen member), or a 20/20/20 spouse. Valid military ID or eligibility for one required. Applicants must be accepted or enrolled. Certificate and licensure study are expressly covered, including eligible AIM NJ nondegree study. No specified major, completed degree or prior-degree bar is published. NMFA employees, volunteers and board members are excluded. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: New Jersey Governor’s Industry Vocations Scholarship
entry.summary: New Jersey HESAA — Up to $2,000 per year. Women or students of color as defined by the state rule, with 12 consecutive months of NJ residency before enrollment, HS diploma/GED, household income below $60,000, eligible citizenship or NJ Alternative Aid status, and satisfactory progress. Must be enrolled in an approved construction-related certificate or degree program at a listed NJ school. No completed degree is required in the published criteria. AIM NJ is outside the approved list. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Navy–Marine Corps Relief Society Education Grant
entry.summary: Navy–Marine Corps Relief Society — $500–$3,000. Spouse or qualifying child of an active-duty, retired or qualifying deceased Sailor or Marine. Children must be under 23 on September 30, 2027. Full- or part-time career and technical education is eligible, alongside associate and bachelor programs and a spouse-only master’s route. The CTE pathway does not specify a required completed degree or major. Check AIM NJ school and prior-degree conditions in the 2027 application. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: SEMA Memorial Scholarship for Automotive Students
entry.summary: SEMA Memorial Scholarship Fund — $1,000–$5,000 (published program range). High school senior or at least 18 at application, and a U.S. or Canadian citizen. Permanent or legal residency alone does not qualify. Entering or continuing at a U.S. or Canadian postsecondary school for an automotive-related degree or certification. No prior college degree is specified. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance enrollment alone does not satisfy the automotive requirement. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Pioneer Homefront Scholars Military Spouse Scholarship
entry.summary: Pioneer Military Credit — $1,000. Age 18+ and spouse of an active-duty, Guard, Reserve, career-retired or medically retired military member. The detailed eligibility rules accept accredited vocational certificates or diplomas and associate through doctoral degrees, but the FAQ says advanced degree. Confirm current AIM NJ certificate eligibility with the sponsor. Past winners, sponsor employees/contractors and their immediate families are excluded. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: AAAA Trade School, Licensing and Certification Grant
entry.summary: AAAA TLC Foundation — Amount not published. For AAAA members or spouses, children or grandchildren of current or deceased members. One year of membership generally required, with exceptions for deceased members and uniformed Active Army, Army National Guard and Army Reserve. High school diploma or GED, subject to waiver. Accredited trade-school, licensing or certification enrollment for a career change. Aircraft maintenance and A&P are explicitly listed, so current AIM NJ certificate study can fit. College-level continuing education is excluded. No completed college degree or prior-degree exclusion is stated. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Energy Job Shop Skilled Trades Scholarship
entry.summary: Energy Job Shop — CA$1,000 (Canadian dollars). U.S. or Canadian citizen or permanent resident, age 18+. Recognized U.S. or Canadian trade, technical, apprenticeship or certification pathway, including career changers and workers upgrading skills. The program must support a qualifying trade or industrial career, including transportation. No college degree or prior-degree exclusion is stated. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance is not named and needs program confirmation. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: PMA Educational Scholarship and Tooling Award
entry.summary: Precision Metalforming Association Educational Foundation — $500–$3,000. Graduating high school or postsecondary student pursuing metalforming or manufacturing. Eligible study includes machining, CNC, welding, stamping, tool and die, automation and related accredited programs with at least 20 contact hours. GPA 2.0+. Certificate and apprenticeship paths qualify. No completed degree or prior-degree exclusion stated. The Mid-Atlantic district covers NJ. AIM NJ aircraft maintenance alone is not a verified manufacturing match. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: STEP New Jersey Skilled Trades Scholarships
entry.summary: Skilled Trades Empowerment Project — $500–$2,000. Graduating high school students who live and attend school in NJ and plan postsecondary skilled-trades education. Past fields include diesel, automotive, electrical and welding. No college degree requirement is published. Current adult AIM enrollment alone does not meet the graduating senior rule. Confirm program fit for incoming aviation maintenance students. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Bell 505 B2 Integrated Avionics Maintenance Technician Scholarship
entry.summary: Vertical Aviation International — Course tuition + $1,600 travel stipend. VAI membership. The sponsor lists an A&P license or completed avionics technician training within two years. Its prerequisites additionally describe the non-A&P route as an established aviation avionics technician. Confirm that route with VAI. No college degree is specified. Current AIM NJ enrollment alone does not establish eligibility. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: Monte Mitchell Convention Scholarship
entry.summary: AEA Educational Foundation — Over $1,500 in convention and travel support. Must actively work for an AEA member company in good standing and have never attended an AEA convention. Employer endorsement and an applicant-written essay required. No degree, major or A&P requirement is stated. AIM NJ students qualify only if they separately meet the employment and attendance rules. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: New Jersey Elks Vocational Scholarship · reopening watch
entry.summary: New Jersey State Elks Association — $1,000 in the last round. U.S. citizen and NJ resident. Graduating high school student or within four years of earning a diploma or GED. Current or planned vocational/technical certificate or credential study, including a nondegree trade-school program like AIM NJ if individual rules are met. The funded study cannot be an associate or bachelor’s degree. Prior-degree exclusion not stated. Check official terms; not necessarily open.

entry.title: AIST Trade School Scholarship and Paid Steel Placement · reopening watch
entry.summary: AIST Foundation — $2,600 scholarship plus paid placement in last round. U.S. citizen, minimum 2.5 GPA, at least half-time in a two-year associate, diploma or certificate at an accredited U.S. trade school or community college. Program must align with iron and steel careers, such as industrial or mechanical maintenance. No prior-degree exclusion is stated. The 21-month AIM NJ program needs confirmation on both duration and steel-sector relevance. Check official terms; not necessarily open.
